about: Composition of the 0.2.0 release line (rework spec C7): the core and the C/Python bindings of the working tree, pinned per file by git blob id in core.manifest and bindings.manifest, the packaging and acceptance tooling, and none of the wave-2 features (T9, T12, T13, T14), which stay for a later line. Read by .github/scripts/release_gate.py; the sources check needs no git history: every pinned file must be present with the pinned content, no extra file may sit under the core paths, and no path of later_line_absent may be present. docs/release/v0.2.0-composition.md explains the line. 2026-10-10: squashed onto v0.1.0 for the public preview; the manifest replaced the base-revision comparison. 2026-10-11: repinned for the Zig 0.17.0 migration and the CPython 3.12-3.15 preparation (Py_LIMITED_API 0x030C0000, abi3 floor cp312); the R6 verdict on record names the earlier core 6e62e0d1 only, so the release gate stays closed until the next acceptance names the core of these sources. Later on 2026-10-11: python/bolorgir/_core.c repinned for the explicit (PyObject *) casts of the limited-API build under GCC 14 (manylinux_2_28).

core.patch: the release-line fix: the open-object certificates of src/complete.zig (pattern keys, dependency doom, the maxProperties count), the reachability flags of src/grammar.zig, the owed-name key completion of src/synth.zig, the -Dstrip option of build.zig; its tests tests/test_open_object_dead_ends.py and tests/completion_reference.py, the isolated acceptance runner (benchmarks/t3/run_t3_accept.sh, t3_identity.py, acceptance_pins.json, acceptance-requirements.txt, tests/test_t3_accept_runner.py) and its CHANGELOG entries come with it

partial_paths.python/bolorgir/__init__.py: the release-line file with only __version__ = "0.2.0rc1" changed (no compile_regex, max_rollback_tokens, rollback, validate_tokens)
partial_paths.CHANGELOG.md: the working-tree file without the wave-2 entries of [Unreleased] (the heading stays, empty; the entries move with the later line); the entries of the release-line patch open the Fixed list of [0.2.0]
partial_paths.docs/README.md: the working-tree index without the rows of ADR-0013 to ADR-0017 (their files are later-line paths)

gate.about: Evidence for the final tag (T7b), set by the owner after the gates close: the R6 review verdict and the T8a report, both committed. The release workflow refuses a final tag while either is null, not positive, or bound to another core than the one it builds.

preview.about: GitHub pre-release of an rc tag (owner decision 2026-10-10: public preview 0.2.0rc1 before the final gate). The release workflow builds the core, requires it to be the candidate of this committed, admitted R6 review verdict, and creates a draft pre-release with the wheel, the sdist and SHA256SUMS; nothing goes to PyPI or TestPyPI. The full T8a stays open and the final gate above stays in force for the stable release.
